question: Do the private repositories join the maps through a private twin of the modular star with a read token, or stay out?
rationale: The modular star reads public code only, because this repository is public. Four private repositories are not counted. Including them needs a private twin of the star with a read token; leaving them out keeps one star and a smaller universe.
